migrate.rebuild.heading: Rebuild old payment records
migrate.rebuild.intro_html:
An older version of this site stored less information with each payment. The app cannot refund those payments, because it cannot prove which provider took them.

This page lists the old payment records one run at a time. Each record needs the provider that took it, because your site may have changed provider since. After a record is rebuilt, the app can refund that payment as normal.

The rebuild never contacts the payment provider. It never moves money.
